$comment: Home-screen widgets. scripts/sync-android-widgets.mjs turns this into the Android provider classes, provider XML, labels and manifest receivers; run it after editing. cols/rows are launcher cells (Android 2x2 is roughly the iOS small widget, 4x2 medium, 4x4 large).

widgets.name: InboxWidget
widgets.label: Inbox
widgets.description: Newest messages with sender, time and subject. Taller sizes add avatars and a line of preview.

widgets.name: TriageWidget
widgets.label: Triage
widgets.description: One unread message at a time with archive, delete and reply buttons.

widgets.name: UnreadCountWidget
widgets.label: Unread count
widgets.description: Unread count for the inbox, with the latest senders.

widgets.name: LatestMessageWidget
widgets.label: Latest message
widgets.description: Only the newest unread message.

widgets.name: FolderCountsWidget
widgets.label: Folder counts
widgets.description: Unread counts for up to four folders.

widgets.name: MailShortcutsWidget
widgets.label: Shortcuts
widgets.description: Compose, calendar, contacts and files.

widgets.name: AllAccountsWidget
widgets.label: All accounts
widgets.description: The unified inbox across every signed-in account.

widgets.name: StarredWidget
widgets.label: Starred
widgets.description: Starred messages, newest first.

widgets.name: FavouritePeopleWidget
widgets.label: Favourite people
widgets.description: The people you hear from most, with their unread count.

widgets.name: MailSearchWidget

widgets.name: OutboxWidget

widgets.name: LastDraftWidget

widgets.name: AgendaWidget

widgets.name: MonthWidget

widgets.name: InvitationsWidget
widgets.label: Invitations

widgets.name: FreeTimeWidget

widgets.name: TaskProgressWidget
